description: This PHP class named CalendarAccountValidator is responsible for validating calendar account eligibility for synchronization operations. It checks that the account exists, is not deleted, has an active connection, and possesses a user ID.

classes.name: CalendarAccountValidator
classes.description: A class that provides validation for calendar account objects used in synchronization processes.

methods.name: validateCalendarAccount
methods.description: Validates a given calendar account ID, ensuring the account exists, is active, and properly configured. Returns the CalendarAccount object if validation passes, otherwise throws exceptions.
